confirmedIssues: CANON-N002: computeArchiveSignature omits provenance and status fields; a narrow concurrent-rebuild race can repopulate the cache from pre-patch archive state after patchArchiveEntry invalidation. Transient inconsistency, not data corruption. Still present by design in derived-archive-view.service.ts:262-270.

CANON-N004: listDerivedArchiveViews uses an offset cursor with .take(args.limit + decodedCursor + 1) resulting in O(p²) page reads over page index. Structurally bounded for realistic process sizes but present in convex/derivedArchiveViews.ts.
CANON-N007: listAllArchiveEntries pagination helper is still duplicated in both turn-derivation.service.ts:142-165 and derived-archive-view.service.ts:273-296 with identical implementations.

CANON-N001: Production runtime emits only two of the seven canonical archive entry kinds (user_message and process_event). model_message, reasoning, script_emission, tool_call, tool_result are accepted by infrastructure and exercised by tests but not produced by any checked-in production code path. Accepted platform-standup state per team-impl-log.

CANON-N003: archiveEntries and archiveTurns Convex functions lack the apiKey gate used by derivedArchiveViews. Pattern is consistent with repo convention for other tables but asymmetric with Story 5 hardening. Human ruling pending.
CANON-N006: NullPlatformStore boots without error outside production, potentially masking missing Convex configuration in local/staging environments. Human ruling pending.
CANON-N010: Derived view page limit of 50 may truncate views for processes with 34+ turns; client sections may not surface the next-page cursor. Human ruling pending.
CANON-N011: Default integrated execution payload is a static template; synthesis content is not model-generated. Intentional and documented. Human ruling pending.
CANON-N012: Archive e2e test validates routing and UI against InMemoryPlatformStore, not a real Convex durable-storage round-trip. Acceptable per team-impl-log.
